title: A Counterexample to the Group-Ring Determinant Conjecture
summary: We disprove the unrestricted group-ring Determinant Conjecture. We construct a finitely generated group G and a square matrix over $`\mathbb Z[G]`$ that is invertible over $`\mathbb Q[G]`$ and has Fuglede–Kadison determinant strictly between zero and one. The logarithmic integral defining the determinant is finite.
family_title: A torsion-free group algebra that is not directly finite

review.reason: Constructs a group-ring matrix disproving the unrestricted determinant conjecture.
